Looking at the source text:
Net generation (megawatthours) | 6,690,506 | 48
Electric utilities | 6,020,426 | 38
IPP & CHP | 670,080 | 50

So the net generation for IPP & CHP is 670,080 megawatthours.

Option A is 6,020,426 megawatthours — that's Electric utilities.
Option B is 670,080 megawatthours — that's IPP & CHP.

So the correct answer is B.
